scope: Fit final layer to exact existing trajectory objective; supervised v16 hidden features frozen. Distinguish optimization underfit from data/generalization failure.
selection: Three fixed regularizations evaluated on identical four training-only catalog-prefix folds with matching frozen fold hidden features. Minimum pooled raw position plus0.1 rotation selects regularization before loading validation. Fit final layer once with full-training hidden features. Validation compared with unchanged projected controls and gates.
validation_policy: Only one frozen candidate evaluated; previously exposed validation is not blind confirmation. No confirmation motion read. No failed gate softened, no model promoted.
training_policy: No new hidden training, source data download or split change. Analytic readout weights are actually trained on motion labels; unchanged input schema and observed-motion scaling. This is a research diagnostic, not evidence of product completion.
reproduction: Repeat exact readout fits; compare serialized bytes, deterministic scores and projection results.
